description:
Perform a Chi-Square Goodness of Fit test to determine if Titanic passenger classes were equally distributed.

1. Open the dataset located at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/TitanicSurvival.csv'.
2. Ensure the 'passengerClass' variable is set to the 'Nominal' measurement type (symbol: three colored circles).
3. Navigate to 'Frequencies' > 'N Outcomes (χ² Goodness of Fit)'.
4. Assign 'passengerClass' to the 'Variable' box.
5. Under 'Expected Counts', check the box to display expected counts in the output table.
6. Verify the results show a significant difference (p < .001) with 3rd class overrepresented.
7. Save the analysis result as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/TitanicGoF.omv'.
